subject: hep-th
title_original: Addressing Standard Model Tensions via X17 Vector Boson
authors: Raoul Serao, Aniello Quaranta, Antonio Capolupo
abstract: We investigate the effects of introducing a new vector boson on existing discrepancies within the Standard Model. Our analysis highlights the potential of this particle to alleviate these tensions while serving as a portal to the dark sector. This scenario provides a promising avenue for exploring extensions beyond the Standard Model and motivates further experimental and theoretical studies.
title_relatable: Could a hidden particle explain why physics experiments disagree?
hook: A new vector boson called X17 might resolve persistent discrepancies in Standard Model measurements while connecting to invisible dark matter.
summary: Physicists propose that a previously undiscovered particle could bridge conflicting experimental results in fundamental physics. The X17 boson would act as a gateway between ordinary matter and the dark sector, offering a concrete extension to our best theory of particle physics.
